This is an opportunity to have genuine technical influence, working on platform capabilities that support analytics, machine learning, AI initiatives, and data-driven decision-making at scale. You will be expected to be able to drive forward the transition to AI-Assisted Data Engineering and should have solid experience in this area.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead the design and evolution of Rightmove's data platform, making key architectural decisions that support long-term scalability, reliability, and performance
  • Own the architecture, design and build of shared platform capabilities for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and processing across batch and real-time workloads.
  • Own the integration strategy across tools such as dbt, Spark and Beam
  • Lead the implementation and adoption of data quality, observability, security, testing and deployment including creating and sharing standards
  • Partner closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and product teams to ensure platform capabilities solve real-world problems
  • Evaluate and introduce new technologies, helping the business adopt modern approaches to data engineering and AI-powered workflows, agents and automations
  • Contribute to the data platform roadmap, identifying opportunities for improvement and influencing future investment decisions.
  • Take ownership of growing the team’s technical capability through mentoring, structured feedback, and leading by example, and help engineers at all levels develop

What We're Looking For

  • Significant technical leadership in data engineering or data platform engineering roles, with a track record of leading complex technical initiatives to completion without needing fully formed requirements
  • Strong architectural expertise across modern data & AI platforms, including data ingestion, processing, storage, and transformation.
  • Genuinely cares for the growth and development of engineers around them, investing in mentoring, creating a culture of technical excellence, and supporting others
  • Hands on experience transitioning to an AI-native Data Engineering landscape
  • A strong Python and SQL engineer with experience using dbt, Spark and Terraform
  • Strong experience working with GCP (or a comparable cloud platform), Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD practices.
  • Deep understanding of data storage and modelling principles, including dimensional modelling, lakehouse patterns, and the governance and operational setup of tools like dbt, and applies data security and GDPR principles in platform-level architectural decisions
  • Experience building and operating production-scale data pipelines, balancing performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to influence technical direction, mentor others, and build alignment across teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Our Approach to AI

At Rightmove, we believe software and product are ultimately people problems, and everything we build aims to improve the lives of others. We see AI as a helpful way to create more space for the human side of our work, from understanding real needs to making sure we are solving the right problems in the right way. There is an expectation that you are proactive in exploring how AI can support your own workflow and productivity, and that you approach it with curiosity and an open mind.

Our vision is to give everyone the belief that they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust and belief to make it happen.

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. If all this has caught your eye, you may well be a Rightmover in the making...

People are the foundation of Rightmove - We’ll help you build a career on it.

What We Offer

title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks / Snowflake)
description:
Alpha Financial Markets Consulting (Alpha) is a leading global consultancy to the financial services industry. We are a boutique management consulting firm that offers the world's top industry players a competitive edge through our expertise and industry insight. Our team is of a uniquely high calibre and works across regulated financial markets, bringing deep expertise in insurance, alternative asset markets - including private equity, private credit, infrastructure and real estate - and other specialised financial sectors. This focus enables us to bring relevant, hands-on experience to our clients' most important challenges. We have our headquarters located the United Kingdom, as well as offices in major global financial centres across the United States, France, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, and Asia.

About the role

Our senior data engineers are hands-on leaders of consultants and client teams, building data platforms for clients in regulated financial services - private equity, real estate, fund administration, and specialist insurance. You'll work directly with client stakeholders, from engineering leads to CTOs, delivering production pipelines on Databricks or Snowflake (strong experience in one is sufficient). This is a hands-on build role with client exposure. You'll write code, review architecture decisions, lead junior engineers and explain trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

What you'll do

  • Lead and mentor junior engineers on your delivery workstream, reviewing their code and data model decisions
  • Build reliable ingestion pipelines that move client data from source systems into the platform efficiently and securely
  • Design data models - Data Vault 2.0, Kimball Dimensional etc. that survive audit and give the business one trusted version of the numbers
  • Build pipelines to agreed SLAs and own their reliability in production
  • Work with domain SMEs to translate business logic into pipeline logic that produces correct numbers
  • Bring LLM-based processing into pipelines where it fits, document parsing, entity extraction, unstructured data classification, alongside deterministic logic
  • Build AI-powered business solutions on the platform, agents, search, and applied use cases on Mosaic AI or Cortex, that solve a client problem with trusted data rather than demo a capability
  • Support pre-sales by sizing effort and cost for prospective engagements, contribute to delivery plans, and present technical approach to prospective clients

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years in data engineering, with at least 2 years on Databricks or Snowflake in production (one platform is sufficient)
  • Strong SQL and Python; comfort with PySpark or Snowpark
  • Strong experience with at least one cloud vendor, Azure, AWS, or GCP, including core services beyond the data platform itself (networking, IAM, storage)
  • Working knowledge of dimensional modelling (Kimball) and/or Data Vault 2.0
  • Comfortable presenting technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
  • Track record of setting engineering standards and reviewing others' code for quality, not just correctness
  • Comfortable leading or mentoring junior engineers on a delivery team, and taking ownership of technical decisions

Additional experience we'd value

  • Snowflake or Databricks certifications
  • Familiarity with private markets data (fund administration, private equity/real estate, secondaries) or London Market insurance
  • Experience with supporting tooling such as IaC; Transformation (dbt); DevOps; Data Quality; Data Modelling; Data Glossary/Governance; iPaaS/ELT, Orchestration
  • Some exposure to regulated environments - financial services, insurance, or similarly audited sectors - and awareness of relevant regulatory frameworks including FCA SYSC, DORA, and MiFID II

What the engagement looks like

You'll work closely with client teams, alongside their internal engineers and Alpha consultants in a regulated environment where change control, data lineage and documentation matter. You'll write code, typically tackling the most complex challenges, review code and data model decisions across the team, and take responsibility for a delivery workstream - planning it, running it, and leading the junior engineers working on it.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary
  • Annual performance bonus tied to individual and company outcomes.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including private medical insurance, life assurance, and income protection.
  • Hybrid working model with flexible arrangements to support work-life balance.

title: Innkjøpsleder
description:
I Mapei står LEAN Manufacturing sentralt i hvordan vi løser våre arbeidsoppgaver. Sammen utvikler, produserer og leverer vi noen av bransjens beste løsninger til bygg og anlegg. Dette innebærer en hverdag preget av lagarbeid og god samhandling. For at vi skal være konkurransedyktige, lønnsomme og møte kunders behov, er vi avhengige av en resultatdrevet og forretningsorientert innkjøpsleder som tør å utfordre.

Nå søker vi en analytisk og handlekraftig innkjøpsleder, som vil ha et helhetlig ansvar for innkjøpsarbeidet, herunder forbedre Mapei AS sine innkjøpsbetingelser og utvikle våre relasjoner til leverandører og partnere, både nasjonalt og internasjonalt.

Som innkjøpsleder får du en nøkkelrolle i arbeidet med å sikre kostnadseffektive innkjøp av både råvarer, handelsvarer og transportleverandører. Du er derfor tett på den operative hverdagen og får en bred kontaktflate i organisasjonen. Du vil samarbeide med ledere og fagmiljøer på tvers av virksomheten for å forstå behov, finne gode løsninger og bidra til en effektiv verdikjede.

En sentral del av ansvaret er å bidra til at Mapei har konkurransekraft, lønnsomhet og leveransetrygghet. Det innebærer å ha oversikt over leverandørmarkedet, vurdere muligheter og risiko og lage gode strategier. Du vil også samarbeide tett med vårt sentrale innkjøpskontor for konsernet i Milano, og balansere lokale behov med konsernets retningslinjer og innkjøpsstrategier.

Målet er tydelig: bedre innkjøpsbetingelser og gode leverandørrelasjoner som styrker både lønnsomheten og leveransetryggheten i fabrikkens drift. Som innkjøpsleder får du et tydelig ansvar for å forhandle frem gode vilkår med leverandører og samtidig sikre kvalitet, tilgjengelighet og leveringspresisjon.

Dette er en rolle for deg som har konkurranseinstinkt og tør å utfordre når det er nødvendig. Du må være tydelig og krevende i forhandlinger, samtidig som du bygger gode relasjoner og skaper tillit over tid. Du skal se mulighetene, stille de riktige spørsmålene og tørre å presse på for bedre løsninger. For det du gjør har direkte betydning: for Mapeis konkurransekraft, for vår lønnsomhet og for at fabrikken skal ha det den trenger, når den trenger det.

Vi tilbyr en spennende stilling i et internasjonalt selskap med sterke vekstambisjoner, og mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom Mapeiskolen. Arbeidsmiljøet er godt med særs dyktige og engasjerte kolleger.

For spørsmål om stillingen, kontakt:
- Fabrikksjef, Werner Seigerud, tlf. 909 92 686 eller
- Leder employer branding og rekruttering, Ingeborg Julsrud, tlf. 454 69 562

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad og lære mer om hvordan du kan bidra til vårt team!
Alle henvendelser behandles konfidensielt og vi kontakter referanser kun etter nærmere avtale.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Building an AI‑first organisation is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function — to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve, must drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.

Clinisys has built an unrivalled reputation for deploying complex diagnostic networks and academic centres – and is the only provider to repetitively deliver to all disciplines end-to-end – at scale. Fostering healthier communities.

Role Summary

As a Solution Architect, you will work closely with healthcare and laboratory customers to design, configure and deploy Clinisys LIMS solutions across the UK and Ireland. Acting as a trusted advisor and technical subject matter expert, you will help optimise laboratory workflows, deliver successful implementations and support customers through solution design, testing and go-live.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and deployment of Clinisys LIMS solutions within pathology and laboratory environments.

  • Analyse customer workflows and translate requirements into scalable, best-practice solutions.

  • Act as the technical lead throughout implementation, validation and transition to support.

  • Collaborate with customers, project teams and partners to ensure successful delivery.

  • Drive standardisation, quality and continuous improvement across deployments.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve automation, efficiency, data quality and decision support.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience delivering healthcare IT, LIMS or laboratory software solutions.

  • Strong understanding of pathology laboratory workflows and healthcare regulations.

  • Customer-facing consulting and stakeholder management experience.

  • Experience with healthcare integrations and messaging standards (HL7, FHIR).

  • Knowledge of cloud and hybrid environments, including Azure.

  • Strong problem-solving, solution design and technical troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • UK or Ireland healthcare sector experience preferred.

What We're Looking For

  • A consultative and customer-focused approach.

  • Strong technical leadership and solution design expertise.

  • Interest in emerging technologies, particularly AI and automation.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

  • Flexibility to travel to customer sites and the Woking office when required.


This role requires a working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and the ability to leverage them to improve processes and outcomes. A core understanding of AI concepts is required and must be able to demonstrate the use of AI tools in a professional setting.

Onboarding
As part of our onboarding process, all new employees will be required to attend / travel to the office on their first day of employment. This requirement is essential for onboarding activities, including the identity verification, completion of necessary documentation, receiving your IT equipment, introductions to key team members, and orientation to Clinisys policies and procedures.

title: RCS-Quality Expert CC
description:
RCS-Quality Expert CC

Our leaders shape strategic initiatives, develop passionate teams, and work to improve health outcomes. They advance our mission and exemplify excellence, compassion, teamwork and purpose in all that they do. Indiana University Health is seeking individuals who embody these values to join our team in the role of ROLE.

Summary

This position exists to support Revenue Cycle Services' Total Quality Management team. This position will be responsible for performing various quality reviews, preparing and providing feedback to operational team members as well as other departments, and assisting in the development of Standard Work for team members. This position will help to ensure the accuracy and completeness of clinical medical record documentation and clinical coding as it pertains to assignment of patient status, documentation of care provided, support of billing for services provided and affect that data has on hospital reporting. This position will also be very involved in various quality initiatives across the Indiana University Health system.

Candidate Qualifications

Candidates for the position will be evaluated according to the following criteria and competencies.

  • Requires RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, CPC, CIC, or COC, or an active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Indiana or an active Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) RN license., ASN required, BSN preferred (based on position/focus).
  • Requires High School Diploma.
  • Associate or Bachelor Degree in Health Information Management, Coding, Nursing or Finance is preferred.
  • Six Sigma or Lean Six Sigma training preferred.
  • Requires 5+ years? experience in revenue cycle operations in various positions related to utilization management, coding, billing, collections, payment adjustments, auditing, denial management and medical record completion.
  • Requires ability to read, understand and interpret medical records and other treatment documentation.
  • Requires a high level of interpersonal, problem solving, and analytic skills.
  • Requires effective written and verbal communication skills in both individual and group settings to ensure professional correspondence and presentation to all levels of individuals within the organization (operational team members, leadership ? internal and external to Revenue Cycle, clinicians, physicians, auditors and other external individuals/groups).
  • Requires the ability to establish and maintain collaborative working relationships with others.
  • Requires ability to set and adjust defined priorities as necessary and to process multiple tasks at once.
  • Requires strong attention to detail, problem solving and critical thinking skills.
  • Requires ability to work with and maintain confidential information.

  • Requires proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, Visio & Access).

Connect to Promise - Demonstrates a commitment to IU Health's mission, vision, and values by exhibiting behaviors and delivering results that align with the strategic direction of the organization. Ensure IU Health is working toward its vision of improving the health of all Hoosiers by providing the best care for each person as we practice our values of purpose, excellence, compassion and team.

Quality Reviews - Develops and performs on-going quality reviews on operational team members to ensure appropriate levels of quality performance are being met. Conducts individual feedback sessions with team members to discuss quality review results. Assists with continued review of areas of concern as necessary based on individuals findings. Prepares and submits formal quality reports to operational management on team members? results.

Training & Education - Assists with new team member training in preparation for their move to operations. Evaluates the educational needs of team members based upon findings, trends or as requested by leadership. Assists with the identification and development of training topics/resources for team members.

Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement - Assists with the evaluation, coordination and completion of both internal and external quality reviews/audits within defined time-frames. Serves as a member of various committees/teams both internal and external to Revenue Cycle Services. Monitors departmental compliance with policies/procedures/guidelines/rules and provides suggestions for improvement.

Self-Improvement - Maintains expertise in relevant areas of responsibility (coding, statusing/level of care, certification/authorization, chart completion, etc.).

Communication - Able to communicate professionally, appropriately and effectively via both written and verbal methods with internal and external IU Health individuals/groups.

Special Projects - Provides support for any additional special projects as directed by leadership.

Coverage - Provides coverage in operational areas on both an as needed basis and in an effort to remain current on operational workflow and functions.

Indiana University Health is unlike any other healthcare system and we're looking for team members who share the things that matter most to us. IU Health leaders play a crucial role in advancing the mission of our organization and inspiring teams to make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients. As one of Indiana’s largest employers and the most comprehensive medical system in the state, our vision is to lead the transformation of healthcare through quality, innovation and education, and make Indiana one of the nation’s healthiest states.

IU Health is the largest health system in Indiana with nearly 40,000 team members, 15 hospitals and $8.64 billion in operating revenue. The system’s programs in cancer, cardiovascular, neuroscience, orthopedics, pediatrics and transplants have received national recognition for quality patient care. IU Health, in partnership with the Indiana University School of Medicine, bring together highly skilled physicians, researchers, and educators into close collaboration to provide world-class care for children and adults and improve the health of patients and communities across Indiana.

Indiana University Health is dedicated to a fair hiring process and is committed to equal opportunity and nondiscrimination for all individuals, regardless of age, color, disability, ethnicity, marital status, national origin, race, religion, gender identity, expression, sexual orientation, or veteran status.

title: Customer Advisor - 13.5 Hours (FTC)
description:
Your role in the JoJo story…

Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail, we have the perfect role for you!

Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. This is where you come in - you’ll be the face of JoJo providing a fantastic level of customer care and service that we are renowned for and one we pride ourselves in upholding always. You’ll be guiding, informing, and assisting our customers in the correct purchase of our huge range of clothing and products. This could be an expectant parent, an excited grandparent or other friends or family.

Our B Corp principles are so important, and every member of our teams will always uphold them. As we move into a digital retail world, offering an Omni-Channel customer service is expected as this builds on customer loyalty. As such most of our stores offer Ship from Store or Click and Collect options, you will take ownership of preparing and shipping all such orders daily.

This position is offered as a Fixed‑Term Contract until 30th September 2026.

A peek into your daily adventures:

  • Assisting our customers in many different and sometimes diverse situations, from bra measuring or discussing our maternity wear, to demonstrating a baby carrier to an intrigued parent.

  • Preparing Omni-Channel orders.

  • Liaising with customers in store or via the phone on Omni-Channel orders.

  • Using our digital or virtual learning platforms to continuously develop your knowledge and retail skills.

  • Embracing new product knowledge or learning to increase sales opportunities.

  • Actively listening to our customers’ needs and working out what the best solution is for them.

  • Taking pride in keeping your store looking immaculate.

A typical week would be 1 x 4, 1 x 4.5 and 1 x 5 hour shifts however, flexibility is required in line with store requirements.

Skills that make you shine:

  • Previous retail, customer service and sales experience

  • Competent IT skills and excellent systems ability, with an aptitude to pick up new systems quickly.

  • The ability to learn and retain a high level of product information and be able to communicate this effectively to our customers.

  • You’ll need a self-developing mentality and a curiosity to learn new products independently.

  • We don’t like hard sales techniques, but you’ll need to demonstrate a level of sales ability, which includes active listening skills, empathy, and an understanding of our customers’ needs.

  • You’ll be working within a small team; therefore, the ability to work harmoniously and respectfully is important.

  • Working in a retail environment requires a level of flexibility, most of our stores are open 7 days a week.

  • We like to keep our stores looking tip-top, so you’ll have a keen eye for detail and play a key role in maintaining our standard.

Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are over the school leaver's age. To find out more about the school leaver age for England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland- Please click the following link:

Just to give you a taste of our culture, we’ll be looking for you to:

  • Be a brand ambassador, safeguarding our values and ethos.

  • Demonstrate honesty and respect in every interaction.

  • Foster collaboration and open, active listening

  • Take ownership of all aspects of the role.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Extra day of annual leave for each year you’re with us, up to 38 days.

  • Is it your birthday? Take it off and celebrate!

  • Let’s celebrate JoJo doing well – non-contractual bonus scheme.

  • Helping plan for the future - enhanced pension scheme.

  • Get on the move - cycle to work scheme.

  • Financial wellbeing app - pay yourself 40% of your earned wages whenever you want.

  • Saving scheme with Smart Money Cymru – You do not need to live in Wales!

  • Flexible work options.

  • Enjoy fabulous social events.

  • Give back with volunteer days to support our communities.

  • Prioritise your well-being with our Health and Wellbeing hub.

  • Specsavers voucher – Get a free sight test and contribution towards glasses (T & C’s) apply.

  • We love our products! Enjoy:

    • 40% off JoJo branded lines

    • 25% off full-price NEXT products

    • 10% off NEXT Beauty products

    • Up to 10% off most branded products

  • Embrace an “It’s up to you” learning environment with ongoing training and development opportunities.

Want to know more about JoJo?

We make happy and helpful clothes and products that let children be children – in all their silly, messy, adventurous, noisy, imaginative joy. But we’re not just about selling products; we’re about creating a warm, community-centric environment for our employees and our customers. From 39 locations across the UK and Ireland and a thriving e-commerce platform, we offer a meticulously designed collection of children’s clothing, toys, and essentials designed with love and care: always with children at the forefront of our minds.

As a B Corp, our commitment goes beyond commerce, we strive for a sustainable future and take pride in our responsibilities to the planet and our communities. At JoJo, every role, every task and every day is an opportunity to support, inspire and contribute to the well-being of our teams and our customers.

We embrace and openly welcome people from different cultures, perspectives, and experiences to create a diverse and enriched environment. We work hard to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people, regardless of background to make sure we grow our company sustainably and with different cultural influences. By encouraging a diverse and inclusive workforce, we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

title: Functional Analyst III
description:

The role facilitates competitive digital operations by eliciting, analyzing, validating, and documenting business and functional requirements for the e-commerce ecosystem. This role plays an instrumental part in delivery teams to ensure that digital features, platform enhancements, and omnichannel solutions are delivered according to business needs. The Lead Functional Analyst works closely with cross-functional digital teams—including product owners, UX/UI designer, and engineers to co-create scalable and innovative online solutions. title: Senior People Advisor - 6 month FTC
description:
In a nutshell

At BrightLocal, we're a people-first business. Our success comes from people having a clear purpose, supportive leadership, and the space to do great work together. This role plays a big part in that.

As our Senior People Advisor, you'll be the person managers trust with the situations that matter most and the person their teams are better off with. You'll pair employment law expertise with sound judgment, using both to help managers lead fairly and with care, especially when things get difficult.

This role is as much about people as it is about process. Behind every situation is a manager who wants to do right by their team and an individual who deserves care, and your job is to look after both. We're also a business that's changing quickly in how we work and how we use AI, and that change lands on our people. Part of your job is helping managers and their teams through it well, and every situation is a chance to build their confidence for next time and raise the standard of leadership across the business.

You'll report to the Head of People Experience on a small People team, so there's real ownership from the start and room to shape how we do this. You'll build close working relationships with managers right across BrightLocal, from first-time team leads to senior leaders.

What you'll be doing

Partnering with leaders and teams

  • Be a trusted, approachable point of contact for leaders and managers, someone they can think out loud with.

  • Support leaders with day-to-day people challenges, including:

  • Performance and feedback

  • Change, growth, and evolving roles

  • Provide clear, pragmatic guidance that balances compliance with doing the right thing for people.

Leading people through the challenging moments

The core of the role. When something isn’t going quite right for a manager or an individual, you're the steady hand who sees it through, fairly and with care.

  • Take each situation from the first conversation to resolution, so no one is left wondering what happens next.

  • Support managers through performance and formal capability processes, keeping fairness at the centre.

  • Handle formal matters through to their outcomes, carefully and fairly.

  • Manage long-term and complex absence with genuine care, including occupational health referrals, phased returns and adjustments.

  • Keep records clear and accurate enough to protect everyone if a case escalates.

Coach managers through the hard conversations

  • Prepare managers for the conversations they're dreading, including what they'll actually say.

  • Help them spot issues early, so that informal resolution can work before things escalate (this is really important to us).

  • Tell a manager directly when their preferred course of action may not be the right one for the individual or the business.

Look after the person, not just the process

  • Make sure anyone in a formal process understands what's happening, what their rights are and what comes next.

  • Hold the balance between what's right for the individual and what's right for the business, and stay honest that the balance isn't always a comfortable one.

  • Signpost wellbeing and mental health support whenever it's relevant, and notice when someone needs it before they ask.

Keep us consistent and compliant

  • Keep policies, letters, and process guidance current and genuinely usable.

  • Flag legal risk early, and know which cases we can run ourselves and which need external advice.

  • Track changes in employment law and turn them into practical changes to how we work.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone who

  • Genuinely connects with BrightLocal’s beliefs and brings them to life in their work.

  • Is practical, thoughtful, and confident enough to challenge when needed.

  • Sound working knowledge of UK employment law, and the judgment to apply it to delicate real situations rather than textbook ones.

  • A track record of coaching and influencing managers, including senior ones, and holding your position when challenged.

  • Delivery focused: You’re comfortable working with ambiguity and lean on your creative problem-solving skills to generate ideas and move them forward quickly.

  • Is comfortable working in change and helping others find clarity.

  • Sound handling of confidential and sensitive information.

  • Experience in fast-paced, dynamic environments and managing multiple priorities effectively.

Nice to have

  • CIPD qualification at any level.

  • Experience in a small or growing business, where you've built the process rather than inherited it.

The type of person who thrives here

  • Genuinely people-first: you treat each situation as someone's working life, not a task to close out.

  • Balanced and fair: you see every angle and stay even-handed, even when it's difficult.

  • Honest with care: you don't shy away from the hard message, but you deliver it thoughtfully.

  • Trusted quickly: people at every level open up to you and believe you'll handle information and situations well.

  • Discreet by instinct: confidentiality isn't a rule you follow; it's simply how you operate

  • Considered but action-led: you understand the grey areas and still help people move forward with confidence.

The Perks (The important details)

  • Salary: Competitive

  • Hybrid working: 2 days a week in our Brighton office for full-time team members

  • Holiday: 25 days + bank holidays + your birthday off

  • Duvet days: 3 duvet days per year

  • Healthcare: Vitality Healthcare

  • Learning & Development: £1,000 per annum personal learning budget

Our commitment to inclusion

At BrightLocal, we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a team where everyone feels welcome, supported, and able to do their best work. When people feel they belong, great things happen.

We strongly encourage applications from women and underrepresented groups in our industry. If this role excites you, but you do not meet every single requirement, we would still love to hear from you. Research shows that some people are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. Your experience, perspective, and potential matter more than ticking every box.

We are open to flexible working arrangements and are happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. If you need anything to feel comfortable and confident applying, just let us know. We are here to help.

title: Senior Media Systems Engineer
company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
location: Bristol, Connecticut, United States of America
description:
This is an onsite position and must sit in Bristol, CT four (4) days a week.

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

  • Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
  • Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
  • Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Job Summary:

Disney Media Systems Engineers have a clear charter: to transform the capability and flexibility of how Disney acquires, produces, and distributes content worldwide, all while ensuring the highest levels of quality, efficiency, and resiliency.

Disney Media Systems Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware and software-based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer- facing linear and digital video/audio content.

Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more. The Sr. Media Systems Engineer acts as a technical leader and is responsible for the design and implementation working closely with management and Executive Leadership to make recommendations and advance Disney’s technical posture.

The Media Systems Engineer will work with vendors and industry trade organizations to define and evolve industry standards, solutions that impact our business. The Sr. Media Systems Engineer will lead and own all aspects of the design and build of Disney’s most impactful projects and will leverage their experience to create documentation, procedures, and standards that drive all our technological development.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible and play lead role for technical implementation of traditional broadcast production systems and cloud -based infrastructure that support content acquisition, production, encoding, decoding, and content distribution across multiple DE&E Technology networks (linear, digital, and streaming platforms).
  • Take lead role on projects to modernize our legacy media production infrastructure systems to make way for advancements such as SMPTE ST 2110, 4K, UHD HDR, JPEGxs, NDI, ProRes Raw, H.265, AV1, including multi resolution support across broadcast facilities (720p/1080/4K/UHD/HDR), metadata conversion, audio mapping, system outages, microservices architecture tunning and related technical problems.
  • Take lead role and coordinate the construction of facilities, upgrades and the installation of equipment including core routing, intercom, playout, distribution systems, non-linear edit systems, graphics, video servers, storage solutions, file acquisition, file transcode, file transfer, media asset management and automation systems. Collaborate closely with installation engineers, equipment manufacturers, vendors, technical operations staff, and others involved in the projects.
  • Collaborate closely with DE&ET and operations’ management to assess facility needs. Develops project plans, schedules, and capital planning, forecasting and estimations. Collaborates closely with equipment manufacturers and vendors to understand the range of equipment that might be relevant to support broadcasting facilities and operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of broadcast engineering experience
  • Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or comparable field of study and/or equivalent work experience
  • Strong understanding of baseband/IP video, audio and digital compression, transport systems, audio/video encoding/transcoding techniques and formats.
  • Knowledge of file transfer acceleration technologies and techniques.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD
  • Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, HTTP, UDP, SSL, and SNMP.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following languages: Perl, Python, Ruby, Shell, C or C++.
  • Familiar with SMPTE standards for broadcast television and video production/streaming environments with a current certification such as not limited to ST 292M, ST 424M, ST 2110, ST 2059, IEE1588, ST 2022-7, SCTE-104, etc.
  • Knowledge and experience with on-prem and cloud-based storage and compute infrastructure platforms and current technological offerings. File-based workflows like enterprise Media Asset Management systems (Cloud-based Cloud Compute or Local Network-based) including storage, compute, encode and distribution.
  • Knowledge and experience with compression techniques such as MPEG2/4, HEVC, JPEG 2000, and JPEG XS.
  • Knowledge and experience with major media systems and the vendors that supply them in areas such as signal routing infrastructure, intercom, playout, asset management systems, file-based workflows, media acquisition, transcoding/encoding, graphics, and NAS/SAN technologies.

#DISNEYTECH

title: Enterprise Account Partner
description:
Fourth is the global leader in workforce and inventory management for the restaurant and hospitality industry, serving enterprise brands across thousands of locations worldwide. Our platform —HotSchedules, MacromatiX, and iQ Analytics — is backed by growing investment in AI-powered capabilities, and we expect every EAP to be at the forefront of that shift.

Interested in joining our smart, fun, and talented team?

Position Overview

Own the full Executive Account Partner mandate independently across a $9–12M ARR book of enterprise restaurant and hospitality accounts as the primary product-facing partner. You resolve novel, cross-product problems without routine escalation and deliver the role at full strategic depth. This is the core operating level of the EAP model.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain executive-level (VP / C-suite) relationships as the trusted senior point of contact across your portfolio.

  • Own account strategy and move each account's adoption maturity and roadmap alignment forward over time.

  • Leveling — three-dimensional capability framing (product knowledge, executive presence, adoption and ROI ownership), with the "capability, not tenure" statement

  • Estate management — adoption monitoring across every location, identifying underperforming units, targeted gap/closure plans, with the revenue-leakage-compounds framing intact.

  • Escalation ownership accountable for the customer relationship, owning communication through every escalation; Support and Professional Services own the fix.

  • Conduct frequent Executive Business Reviews, often to a C-level audience, translating product usage into measurable business outcomes — labor cost, compliance, scheduling efficiency, turnover.

  • Responsible for Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) across your portfolio, partnering with the commercial team on contract execution, signings, and renewals. GRR is a key metric this role is evaluated on. Proactively identify expansion opportunities and collaborate on recommended strategy; Commercial Team owns the resulting pipeline and revenue

  • Lead recovery strategy on at-risk relationships.

  • Drive product adoption and articulate value in the customer's operational terms, engaging Manager and Director-level operations stakeholders.

  • Independently diagnose novel, cross-product adoption and configuration problems across HotSchedules and MacromatiX; channel enhancement opportunities to Product.

  • Confidently recognize suboptimal integration and data-flow setups (FTP vs. API, HS/MX to iQ) and identify the better path, engaging specialists where design or build work is required.

  • Understand the operational and financial implications of feature adoption — what it means to implement a capability, and equally what it means not to.

  • Use AI tools — including Claude — to streamline your workflows, accelerate account research, and speak credibly to how AI capabilities within Fourth's platform create value for customers.

  • Orchestrate concurrent customer workstreams (product/feature rollout, adoption strategy, integration architecture) keeping the customer's operational goals aligned to Fourth's roadmap

  • Own the account across the full customer lifecycle — active engagement during implementation, not a handoff and a check-in.

  • Partner with Professional Services on implementations and at-risk delivery — you are the business-level continuity when delivery gets complicated.

  • Collaborate with Support to ensure escalations are resolved with urgency and that patterns in a client's ticket volume inform their adoption plan.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer into Fourth's Product and leadership teams, feeding product gaps, adoption blockers, and competitive intelligence through defined cadences.

  • Maintain in-person executive presence through regular onsite customer visits (~25% travel), with cadence guided by account size and strategic priority.

Key Skills and Competencies

  • 5+ years in customer success, account management, or a related client-facing role in SaaS; enterprise restaurant or hospitality industry experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven independent ownership of enterprise accounts with a track record of driving retention and expansion outcomes.

  • Established credibility engaging C-level executives on strategic value; operating fluency in the customer's business.

  • Advanced product depth across workforce management, scheduling, or inventory management platforms with strong troubleshooting instinct.

  • Experience working cross-functionally across Sales, Product, Support, and Professional Services.

  • Proficiency using AI tools to accelerate workflows; comfort speaking to AI-powered product capabilities with enterprise customers.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and API-based integration concepts.

Measures of Success

  • Portfolio adoption maturity and business-review outcomes that hold up at the executive level.

  • Net revenue retention outcomes — retention rate, expansion revenue, and quality of commercial-team partnership.

  • Demonstrated proficiency across the role's core competency areas, particularly executive presence and strategic account progression.

Environmental and Physical Demands

  • ~25% domestic travel to customer locations. Cadence guided by account size and strategic priority.

Fourth Benefits

🏖 Unlimited PTO!
🏥 Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance!

🏦 401k Match!

👥 Parental Leave

💻 Laptop and equipment.

Remote employment limited to: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MS, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, & WA


Our Story

In July 2019, Fourth joined forces with HotSchedules to become the global leader in end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. Together, the merged company now represents the world’s largest and only provider of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management solutions for customers across the globe and of all sizes—from a single location or franchisee restaurant to a global restaurant or hotel chain. The combined company’s complete software-as-service (SaaS) solution suite, including scheduling, time & attendance, applicant tracking, training, inventory management/procurement, HR/benefits, and payroll services, now serves customers in 120,000 locations worldwide and is supported by a dedicated, unified team across offices in the US, UK, Bulgaria, China, Australia, and UAE.

description:

Monday - Friday

Weekend and holiday rotation

General Summary

Provides basic athletic training services for patients/athletes at designated setting.

Essential Functions:

  • High School/Athletic Events Coverage: • Covers assigned pre-season physicals, sports games or matches and related events and supervises onsite treatments and programs of reconditioning for injured athletes under the supervision of the team physician, sports medicine program coordinator and medical director. • Carries out all prescribed treatments and recommendations made by the team physician and communicates appropriately with the rest of the interdisciplinary care team. • Maintains relationships with referring physicians, businesses, schools, coaches and other referral sources within local community. • Utilizes appropriate, sound and up-to-date clinical techniques to effectively assess and treat athletic injuries. • Records athletic injuries and treatments as rendered and maintains the records in accordance with the district/organization/WellSpan guidelines for which service is provided. • Assists the examining physician in implementation of pre-participation examinations for prospective athletes and measures patient’s/student’s progress and level of function in a manner appropriate for specific age groups. Continues to work cooperatively with physicians and other care team members (including parent/guardian) by advising of any change in athlete’s progress through an ongoing status report. • Assists physical therapists in the treatment of patients with sports or orthopedic conditions referred for rehabilitation. The physical therapist will evaluate the patient, set goals and monitor progress. The athletic trainer will assist with the implementation of the treatment plan. • Maintains, orders, and organizes everyday supplies necessary to deliver proper evidence-based treatment of athletes within the guidelines of the department. • Actively participates in departmental performance/quality improvement program(s) to achieve measurable and sustained levels of improvement ensure quality outcomes and customer experience for the athlete/school/organization.
  • Medical Office Orthopedics: • Assists physicians in the care and treatment of patients with orthopedic needs. • Provides physician clinic support through obtaining patient histories, completing preliminary musculoskeletal assessments to assist with triaging of imaging and physician interaction, communicating findings with physician to facilitate efficient physician assessment, and completing appropriate documentation in the electronic medical record. • Designs and instructs patient home exercise programs for patients as needed. • Fits and adjusts durable medical equipment including but not limited to braces, canes, crutches, and walkers. • Provides in office post-operative patient care per established protocols as instructed by orthopedic surgeons to include dressing changes, home education/care, and home exercise program. Helps facilitate transition of care to Rehabilitation services by updating rehabilitation scripts with surgery details and rehab protocol and communicating with therapists. • Assists with application of casts and splints for all types of fractures and educates patients on cast and splint care. • Applies simple braces, prosthetics, performs minor adjustments and repairs, as well as fabricate splints for various conditions under the direction of the orthopedic physician. • Documents clinical care appropriately in EMR. • Assists with clinic flow by rooming and discharging as needed, as well as patient education and clinical follow up.

title: Head of DevOps, Platform as a Service
description:
EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide.

But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork.

Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time.

We are looking to hire a Head of DevOps to build and lead our Platform as a Service Chapter, a team that overtime will grow to 5-10 DevOps and hosting engineers. You will own our private cloud infrastructure as a product and turn it into a set of secure, self-service CI/CD and hosting services that our development teams can call on demand, so that increasing storage or standing up a new server is a service request rather than a project. We are searching for an open-minded leader who is technical enough to challenge an architecture and set engineering standards, but whose day job is building the team, defining the service catalogue and being accountable for what the platform delivers.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and lead the Platform as a Service Chapter, overtime grow it to a team of 5-10 DevOps and hosting engineers;

  • Own our private cloud infrastructure as a product, setting the technical direction and the roadmap for how it evolves;

  • Define and publish a service catalogue with clear ownership and clear interfaces, so that provisioning compute, storage, environments and infrastructure is a self-service call for our development teams;

  • Deliver secure CI/CD as a service, with pipelines, secrets management, access control and compliance controls built into the platform by default rather than added afterwards;

  • Set, measure and report on SLAs, capacity plans and cost transparency for every service the chapter provides;

  • Establish the engineering standards of the chapter, including infrastructure as code, peer review, automated testing and observability, and hold the team to them;

  • Embed AI-assisted engineering in how the chapter works day to day, and measure the effect it has on delivery speed and quality;

  • Partner with development, architecture and security so that platform capabilities match what our product teams need;

  • Take accountability for the reliability of the platform, including on-call arrangements, incident response, and post-incident learning.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience leading a platform, infrastructure or DevOps team, including line management, hiring and developing engineers;

  • Track record of delivering infrastructure as a self-service product, with a defined service catalogue, agreed SLAs and users outside your own team;

  • Strong working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes and Helm, and of the operational reality of running them at scale;

  • Experience with CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and with the security controls that belong inside a pipeline

  • Familiarity with clusters such as Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch, and with configuration management (Ansible or similar);

  • Experience with infrastructure provisioning tools (e.g. Terraform);

  • Experience operating on-premises or private cloud infrastructure, including capacity planning and cost management;

  • Comfortable in an environment where legacy software on both Linux and Windows is supported alongside a modern microservices estate;

  • Able to embed AI-assisted engineering into the way a team works, and to hold that team to measurable outcomes from it;

  • Good understanding of the software development life cycle, from planning to deployment, able to identify bottlenecks across teams and come up with solutions to them.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with observability, built into a platform as a default rather than as an add-on;

  • Experience with a legacy monolith application being migrated to a microservices architecture on on-prem infrastructure, and with the automation needed to make everything run smoothly;

  • Exposure to a regulated industry, where auditability and access control are part of the design;

  • The person needs to be open-minded and proactive, willing to test and learn new things all the time, and comfortable leading a team through change.

Here's what we offer:

  • Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us.

  • Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment, in line with the company policy.

  • Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter.

  • 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required.

  • Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance.

  • Private Medical Subscription.

  • Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training.

  • Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health.

Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym?

At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference!

EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

  • Develop and implement automated provisioning solutions for applications and infrastructure. · Provision and maintain cloud infrastructures in Azure.

  • Design, implement, and maintain Identity Provider (IdP) integrations including Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, and Okta, ensuring secure and seamless authentication and authorization across systems.

  • Provide operational and system expertise to software delivery teams.

  • Resolve issues reported via Service Desk systems.

  • Maintain documentation including server build docs, configuration standards, infrastructure architecture.

  • Develop corrective action plans and Root Cause Analysis documents for both internal and client distribution.

  • Executing closely activities for automating and streamlining infrastructure operations and DevOps processes.

  • Build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring and operations leveraging the latest technologies including Agentic AI.

  • Ensure that the technical environment is properly monitored and correctly used and the timely resolution of technical issues.

  • Identify system performance issues and oversee the development and correct use of tools to resolve these problems.

  • Support & maintain both customer-facing production environments as well as QA and Development environments.

  • Report & manage risk in line with ISO 27001 controls.

  • Preserve assets, information security and control structures.

Qualifications

A great candidate will have:

  • Bachelor's degree in technical/STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics) field or equivalent work experience.

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in this role.

  • Understanding of various DevOps tools for developing digital pipelines.

  • Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for computing environments.

  • Capability of specifying, designing, and/or implementing system health, performance monitoring tools.

  • Knowledge of Cloud platforms and preferably Azure including but not limited to Azure Kubernetes Services, Log Analytics, Function Apps, Logic Apps, Storage accounts, Synapse Analytics, Analysis Services, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks.

  • Solid expertise with Identity Providers (IdPs), including Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace Identity, and Okta — covering SSO, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, Auth0 protocols.

title: Island Environmental Steward - Bahamas
description:
Every day at Disney Cruise Line we take pride in bringing the magic of Disney to life. We find joy in creating cherished memories and form genuine connections with our guests. The Island Environmental Steward is responsible for assisting with managing the receipt, processing, and disposal of all general, recyclable, and hazardous waste on Disney's private island in the Bahamas. This role includes operating and maintaining waste management equipment, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations, and supporting waste diversion goals. You will report to the Environmental Manager

• Identifying and bringing forward new processes and procedures to improve waste management and recycling onboard.
• Follow the terms of the employment contract.

• Minimum of one to two years’ experience in Environmental Management or related field
• Knowledge of hazardous materials
• High School Diploma
• Proficient in Windows applications and email
• Detail oriented individual
• Strong planning and organizational skills
• Knowledge of Safety and Environmental practices

This role is based on Disney’s private island in the Bahamas.

Applicants must:

title: Director, Value Strategy, US Market Access

At AstraZeneca, we turn ideas into life changing medicines. Working here means being entrepreneurial, thinking big and working together to make the impossible a reality. We're focused on the potential of science to address the unmet needs of patients around the world. We commit to those areas where we think we can really change the course of medicine and bring big new insights to life.

The Director, Value Strategy and Evidence, Oncology is an integral member of the U.S. Market Access organization and is responsible for the development and implementation of bespoke innovative reimbursement and payment models (i.e., Innovative Value Strategies (IVS) at key customers within the U.S. business.

The Director will closely partner with peer colleagues across numerous functions (namely, Contract Strategy, National and Regional Account Teams, Medical Affairs, Global R&D, Access Strategy, Data Science, Actuary, HEOR, and Global Pricing Strategy, Insights & Analytics, Government Affairs & Policy). She/he will be responsible for synthesizing clinical trial data, real world evidence, and competitive market intelligence, while ascertaining value drivers for payer and health system customers. The director will create IVS frameworks (e.g., value-based contracts) and own end-to end development, market implementation, adjudication, outcomes and financial reporting to support brand access strategies at launch and throughout the product life cycle. Specific responsibilities of the role include:

  • Synthesis of Evidence & Gap Analysis/Environmental Analysis:

  • Lead cross-functional working groups to develop IVS for oncology brands

  • Analyzing RCT/RWE/HEOR & other data

  • Writing protocols for data extraction and synthesis

  • Conducting market and reimbursement landscape assessments and health policy research

  • Conducting market research

  • Leading customer engagement

  • Conducting performance reviews with internal and external stakeholders

The Director will be a strategic, high- performing, independent, self-starting leader with clinical and business-focused technical training. The director will also have demonstrated experience analyzing TPPs, applying HEOR/RWE, and building analytic models for purposes of delivering strategic market access solutions (payer-facing experience is strongly preferred). Strong communication skills, business acumen, and ability to influence without authority in a matrix environment is essential. Proficiency in using AI, Excel, PowerPoint, and other productivity and project management software is essential. A working knowledge/understanding of actuarial analysis and financial modeling is required.

Demonstrated Abilities and Performance Indicators:

  • Analytic rigor

  • Clinical training (oncology preferred)

  • Demonstrated business acumen

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated leadership in a matrix environment

  • Highly motivated

title: Senior Backend Engineer - UK
description:
Who is Heidi?

Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that supports clinicians every step of the way, from documentation to delivery of care.

We exist to double healthcare’s capacity while keeping care deeply human. In 18 months, Heidi has returned more than 18 million hours to clinicians and supported over 73 million patient visits. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi across 116 countries and over 110 languages.

Founded by clinicians, Heidi brings together clinicians, engineers, designers, scientists, creatives, and mathematicians, working with a shared purpose: to strengthen the human connection at the heart of healthcare.

Backed by nearly $100 million in total funding, Heidi is expanding across the USA, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with major health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, MaineGeneral, and Monash Health, among others.

We move quickly where it matters and stay grounded in what’s proven, shaping healthcare’s next era. Ready for the challenge?

The Role

A Senior Software Engineer responsible for the execution of the backend features, with a deep technical understanding and how it translates to representing user needs. You will have operated in a hyper growth startup with experience building SaaS products.

You will also have a deep understanding of the key challenges engineers face and a firm grasp on design principles in prioritizing key features and capabilities.

Your superpower is how to bridge the gap between technical specifics and business needs effortlessly and turn high-level designs into real-world solutions.

You thrive in challenging situations, and you appreciate the dynamics of a flexible, flat-structured work environment. You are quick to grasp the nuances and complexities of developing an AI product healthcare internationally.

We know that brilliant people can come from unlikely places; if you have a proven track record of shipping spectacular technically challenging products and features, regardless of industry, we want to meet you.

What you'll do:

Ultimately you will have the opportunity to work with the engineering mastermind behind Heidi developing AI products which will change the face of healthcare

  • Autonomously deliver beautiful & robust code with considerations on code structure design and scalability.
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions.
  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance backend systems using Python.
  • Architect and manage cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability and reliability.
  • Develop and manage message queue systems for real-time data processing.
  • Collaborate with frontend and AI teams to integrate new features and enhance existing APIs.
  • Optimize API performance and handle API versioning, documentation, and testing.

What we’ll look for:

  • Strong sense of ownership & strong problem-solving skills.
  • 5+ years of backend development experience.
  • Solid experience with MongoDB and Redis for data management.
  • Experience building & managing message queue systems at scale.
  • Writing testable, effective and communicative code
  • Data modeling, design patterns, understanding trade-offs
  • Deep understanding of API design principles, including security, versioning, and performance.
  • Data & application security knowledge and skills
  • Experience in integrating with third‑party systems
  • Competent with source code control and CI/CD pipeline technologies.
  • Architecting and building highly available, scalable, secure & performant systems

What do we believe in?

Heidi builds for the future of healthcare, not just the next quarter, and our goals are ambitious because the world’s health demands it. We believe in progress built through precision, pace, and ownership.

  • Live Forever - Every release moves care forward: measured, safe, and built to last. Data guides us, but patients define the truth that matters.
  • Practice Ownership - Decisions follow logic and proof, not hierarchy. Exceptional care demands exceptional standards in our work, our thinking, and our character.
  • Small Cuts Heal Faster - Stability earns trust, speed delivers impact. Progress is about learning fast without breaking what people depend on.
  • Make others better - Feedback is direct, kindness is constant, and excellence lifts everyone. Our success is measured by collective growth, not individual output.

Our mission is clear: expand the world’s capacity to care, and do it without losing the humanity that makes care worth delivering.

Why you should Join Heidi

  • Real product momentum. We're not trying to generate interest, we're channeling it.
  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You'll share directly in the success you help create.
  • Unmatched impact. Play a pivotal role at a critical growth moment - working on a product that delivers tangible, real-world value to clinicians and patients every day.
  • Work alongside world‑class talent. Join a team of operators and builders who've scaled unicorns.
  • Your health, covered. Comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, plus 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder and a £100/month Healthy Heidi’s stipend.
  • Global parental leave. 26 weeks paid for primary carers and 18 weeks for secondary carers, subject to eligibility.
  • Fertility support. £7,000 one‑off payment, eligibility applies.
  • Learning & development. £700 per year for courses, books, memberships, conferences and more.
  • Home office budget. £500 one‑off to set up a workspace you actually want to work in.
  • Recharge days after major milestones and busy periods so you can reset and come back strong.
  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year, wherever the world takes you.
  • Clinical leave. 10 days per year for eligible clinical roles to maintain accreditation and requirements.
  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Compliance Reporting Data Analyst II
description:
Why Compliance Reporting & Analytics at GM Financial?

The Compliance Reporting & Analytics Team helps GM Financial’s Compliance organization turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. We partner with leaders across Compliance globally to develop executive reporting, dashboards, and analytics that increase transparency, strengthen governance, and inform key business decisions.

What makes our team unique is the breadth, visibility, and impact of our work. We support all areas of Compliance, giving us the opportunity to connect data across functions, identify opportunities for improvement, and help shape how information is reported and used. Our team is also focused on automation, analytics, and emerging technologies, making this a great opportunity for someone who wants to contribute to meaningful work while helping modernize how Compliance operates.

About the role:

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining Compliance reporting, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics that provide insight into risks, controls, regulatory obligations, and program effectiveness. The position partners with business and technology teams to ensure data quality, deliver actionable reporting, improve processes through automation, and support informed decision-making across the organization.

In this role you will:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance Compliance dashboards, reports, executive reporting materials, and ad hoc analyses.
  • Develop, implement, monitor, and maintain KPIs and performance metrics used to measure Compliance activities, risks, controls, regulatory obligations, and program effectiveness based on business requirements.
  • Partner with Compliance leaders and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Develop and monitor data quality controls to ensure the integrity, reliability, and governance of data used for Compliance reporting products.
  • Administration and maintenance of databases, data models, data mappings, reporting repositories, and GRC reporting tools utilized for Compliance reporting.
  • Analyze data to identify trends, emerging risks, performance gaps, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Prepare and deliver executive and operational reporting in a clear, concise, and actionable format.
  • Document and maintain reporting methodologies, KPI definitions, business rules, calculations, data sources, and reporting procedures to support auditability and sustainability.
  • Lead or support initiatives that improve reporting efficiency through automation, standardization, business intelligence tools, and process enhancements.
  • Collaborate with business partners, technology teams, and data owners to resolve reporting issues, improve data quality, and support evolving reporting needs.

What makes you an ideal candidate?

  • Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Experience with Power Query, DAX, SQL, SAS, and similar data modeling, transformation, and analytical tools.
  • Ability to use Generative AI tools like Microsoft Copilot in work processes.
  • Ability to organize, combine, and transform data from multiple systems using data modeling, relationships, and business logic to support reporting and analytics.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative skills with the ability to identify trends and derive actionable insights from data.
  • Understanding of data governance, data quality management, reporting controls, and reporting lifecycle management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Creative, user-focused mindset with an eye for dashboard design, data visualization best practices, and user experience (UX), ensuring reporting solutions are intuitive, insightful, and visually effective.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Working effectively within an AI enabled environment.

Work Experience & Education

  • 2-4 years in a similar role required.
  • Experience in consumer compliance and quantitative methods or business reporting metrics preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field required.

What We Offer: Generous benefits package available on day one to include: 401K matching, bonding leave for new parents (12 weeks, 100% paid), tuition assistance, training, GM employee auto discount, community service pay and nine company holidays.

Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation: Competitive pay and bonus eligibility.

Work Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work environment, 2-days a week in office.

NOTE: We are unable to consider candidates who require visa sponsorship for this position.

This position is not open to agency submissions.
