title: Sampling Assistant
description:
Are you excited about hands-on fieldwork and contributing directly to climate action? Join InPlanet as a Sampling Assistant, supporting the collection of high-quality field data that helps us measure the impact of our Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) projects.
You’ll work closely with our Science team to collect soil and other field samples, maintain accurate records, prepare equipment, and support sampling activities across our partner farms. This is a practical, field-based role for someone who enjoys working outdoors, following clear protocols, and being part of a collaborative team.
Field Sampling
  • Collect soil and other field samples according to InPlanet’s protocols and quality standards.
  • Support the marking and identification of sampling locations.
  • Assist with field measurements and other data collection activities.
  • Help ensure samples are correctly labelled, stored, and prepared for transportation.

Sampling Preparation & Logistics
  • Prepare sampling materials, tools, labels, and equipment before each field activity.
  • Support the organization, packing, transportation, and return of field equipment.
  • Help coordinate sampling routes and activities with the wider team.
  • Travel regularly to farms and project sites within the region.

Documentation & Data Quality
  • Accurately record sampling information using the required forms and digital tools.
  • Check that sample labels and field records are complete and consistent.
  • Report any deviations, missing information, or field issues to the responsible team member.
  • Support sample traceability from collection through delivery to the inventory or laboratory team.

Equipment Care & Safety
  • Clean, organize, and carry out basic checks on sampling tools and equipment.
  • Identify equipment issues and communicate when maintenance or replacement is needed.
  • Follow all health, safety, and fieldwork procedures.
  • Help keep vehicles, materials, and working areas clean and organized.

Team Collaboration
  • Work closely with Science, Operations, Inventory, and farm teams to complete sampling activities safely and efficiently.
  • Communicate clearly about field progress, challenges, and changes to the plan.
  • Contribute to a respectful and collaborative relationship with farmers and local partners.
Core Skills & Experience
  • Completed or ongoing technical training or degree in Agronomy, Agriculture, Environmental Management, Biology, Soil Science, or a related field.
  • Availability to work full-time during regular business hours.
  • Interest in hands-on outdoor work and agricultural environments.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.
  • Willingness and availability to travel regularly to farms and project sites.
  • Basic ability to use digital tools for recording information.

Key Qualities
  • You are reliable, organized, and careful with details.
  • You enjoy practical work and being active in the field.
  • You are comfortable working outdoors and adapting to changing weather and field conditions.
  • You communicate clearly and work well as part of a team.
  • You care about sustainability, agriculture, and climate action.
  • You are proactive and willing to learn.


Bonus Points
  • Previous experience with soil sampling, fieldwork, agriculture, or research projects.
  • Familiarity with GPS tools, sampling equipment, or field data collection.
  • A valid driver’s licence and confidence driving in rural areas.
  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 30+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!

title: AI Transformation Working Student
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You work directly with our AI Transformation Catalyst at CHAPTERS Group, helping translate AI capabilities into real business value across 55+ portfolio companies. This is not a research or shadowing role. You take ownership of tasks, run your own analyses, document what works, and help shape how AI adoption spreads across the group. You work in a lean team, directly with senior stakeholders, and you are expected to contribute your own ideas.

What You Will Work On

  • Build AI Hub use cases for real problems in OpCos: custom models with the right knowledge, tools, and prompts, ready for Champions and their teams to use
  • Ship pilot use cases end to end: take an idea from a Champion, build it in the Hub, test it with the OpCo, and hand it over ready to use
  • Build enablement assets on the Hub: prompt libraries, knowledge bases, evaluation setups, and custom models that make it easier for new OpCos to get started
  • Scout emerging AI capabilities (models, agents, tools, integrations) and translate the useful ones into Hub configurations Champions can pick up
  • Research and document validated use cases in a structured format: problem, affected role, time saved, solution, and transferability across OpCos
  • Draft internal communications, playbooks, and best-practice guides that help Champions and OpCo managers get started quickly
  • Track adoption metrics across OpCos and prepare concise status updates for the AI Core team and leadership
  • Prepare materials for Champion onboarding, training workshops, and the monthly AI Champions League calls

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Currently enrolled in a Business, Economics, or related programme (Master's preferred)
  • AI native: you use AI tools daily as part of how you work, not as a novelty
  • Builder mindset with hands-on project experience: automations built in n8n, prototypes in Cursor or Lovable, or any project that shipped
  • Prior work experience through an internship, working student role, or your own venture, ideally in a startup or tech-adjacent environment
  • You translate technical AI capabilities into business language: you talk about time saved and cost avoided, not model architectures
  • Comfort with data: you can pull numbers from a spreadsheet, spot a trend, and explain what it means for a decision
  • Highly self-directed: you move forward with incomplete information, ask the right questions, and synthesize fast
  • Strong written communication in English (fluent) and German (fluent or native)

Bonus

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG concepts, or custom AI model configuration
  • Experience using Claude Code or Codex
  • Background or coursework in change management, organisational development, or innovation management
  • Experience working in or with B2B software companies or vertical SaaS environments

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • Direct daily collaboration with the AI Transformation Catalyst: real sparring, not task assignment from a distance
  • Exposure to a live enterprise AI rollout across 55+ companies: strategy, enablement, and the messy middle in between
  • Access to the full CHAPTERS AI Hub: Anthropic, OpenAI, custom models, knowledge bases, and the tools that power real AI workflows
  • A front-row seat at the intersection of AI and business transformation in the DACH software market
  • Real ownership: your own workstreams, not just supporting tasks, and your name on deliverables
  • A network across portfolio companies, platform teams, and the central AI Core team
  • Space to experiment and build: if you have a better way to do something, say so
  • A stepping stone: strong performance opens doors to full-time roles in the AI Core team or across the portfolio

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why does CHAPTERS' model, a portfolio of specialized B2B software companies, appeal to you specifically?
  • What's your unfair advantage for this role?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Saw Operator - 2nd shift
description:
2nd Shift Opportunities' Available

3:00PM - 11:00PM

$20.61/hr with an additional $1.00/hr shift differential.

You deserve the best.... and so do we! Take the first step toward a better future with a career at Howmet Aerospace.

Are you an energetic and dependable employee that takes pride in your craft? Would you like to be part of a dynamic and growing manufacturing business in Barberton, OH? Our organization is dedicated to rapid, profitable growth through continuous capital investment, operational excellence and career development. Howmet is a company that promotes and develops from within with worldwide opportunities and we're looking for someone like you to join our team in an entry level full time Cast House Saw Operator role in a production environment.

If you are interested in training for a new career with our facility, we encourage you to apply!

Company Benefits: We offer eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package designed to assist employees and their families with financial security, health, and well-being. In addition to competitive pay, we off a variety of benefit programs.

  • Medical, Life, Dental and Vision Plans
  • 401(k) Program with a Company Match
  • Performance Pay based on company results
  • Paid vacation accrual
  • 10 annual paid holidays
  • Employee discount programs
  • Starting at $20.61/hr with an additional $1.00/hr shift differential.

WHAT IS A CAST HOUSE?

The Cast House is a structure that holds an aluminum smelter. Howmet Aerospace's smelters are among the safest in the world. Our modern aluminum smelter will require trained and skilled operators.

Position Summary: Operates production equipment to meet quality and production targets. This position will require operators to regularly rotate between duties.

Essential Duties:

  • Follows all safety procedures
  • Operates one or more pieces of equipment in a safe and efficient manner to produce quality products while keeping a quick pace
  • Performs compliance checks and completes paperwork, documentation and reports
  • Completes required paperwork
  • Participates in TPM activities
  • Ensures that 5S requirements are met
  • Assists in problem solving of identified problems in the department
  • Clean equipment and lubricate to keep in like-new condition.
  • Inspects equipment to identify and correct potential failures.
  • Use error-proof/mistake-proof techniques to prevent failure.
  • Identify, respond to, document problems and resolve to root cause.

title: Data Engineer - Core MI
description:
Job Purpose:

  • Responsible for the development and delivery of pipelines (collect, validate and prepare high quality data) to automate and streamline processes required by different departments across the bank.
  • Support existing SSIS ETLs (overnight and intraday), proactively fine-tune and enhance existing codes to increase robustness and error monitoring.
  • Support the internal IT department with changes and upgrades to software platforms.
  • Develop and maintain UK and EU regulatory reports
  • Candidate must be adept in C#, Power BI & .net


Principle Accountabilities and Duties:

Software Development:

  • Analysis of issues pertaining to problems or errors raised by in-house systems, i.e. CORE, SharePoint interface, Equation, Kondor, Eximbills, end of day cycle.
  • Understanding business requirements in order to develop and deliver appropriate solutions based on system definition documents.
  • Proficiency in advanced 4GL programming languages and able to apply to the fully development life-cycle.
  • Keep abreast and apply software development’s best practice.


Database Support

  • To build data pipelines within the SQL environment in SSIS packages, where required, introduce new field and data types for new information to be collated in the CORE environment.
  • To build reports based on business requirements using SQL SSRS.
  • To integrate with all the Bank’s sub-systems using data abstraction and connectivity layers, i.e. ODBC, ADO.net.
  • Ensure that the environment is running optimally and with high standard house-keeping procedures.
  • To build tabular models (SSAS) for different business units.


SharePoint Integration:

  • To integrate the SharePoint environment and Forms with Equation system to introduce automation of processes thereby eliminating the need for duplicate entry.
  • To utilise web services to integrate from cutting edge technology into legacy systems such as Equation.


End of Day Cycle:

  • To provide second and third level support for in-house programmes during the end of day cycle.
  • To be able to analyse and rectify any problems raised in an independent and team scenario.
  • To take ownership of a problem and deliver a solution in a timely manner.
  • Provide out of office hours support.


Risk & Regulatory Duties

  • Maintain knowledge of all applicable regulatory requirements including the Bank's Risk and Compliance policies and procedures and adhere to these to avoid exposing the Bank to undue risk.
  • Report policy/procedure breaches and areas of potential non-compliance and suspicions promptly upon identification in accordance with the Bank's Risk and Compliance policies.
  • Accurately execute all controls within own area to minimise risk of policy, procedure, and/or regulatory breaches.
  • Identify new risks/control gaps within own area and escalate accordingly to your Line Manager.


Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills, Experience Required:


Qualifications/Experience

  • Degree level qualified or equivalent
  • Microsoft SSIS – 7 years plus
  • Microsoft SSAS, SSRS – 2 years plus
  • C# Programming for Web application – 7 years plus
  • Windows application – 2 years plus


Knowledge and Skills

  • Software analysis and design good practice -- essential
  • Second-line and Third-line Application Support -- essential
  • Effective problem solving - essential
  • Critical thinking - essential
  • Dimensional modelling, Entity Relationship modelling, Normalised modelling – desirable
  • Data warehouse design concepts, (Inmon, Kimball) -– desirable
